Definition: from G231; to be a fisher, i.e. (by implication) to fish:--go a-fishing.
BiblicalUsage: The word halieúō carries the sense of go a-fishing. In John 21:3, the text says "I go a fishing. They say unto him."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, halieúō means go a-fishing, and I leave it at that.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Appears to Seven Disciples by the Sea of Galilee
